provenance.desktopEncoding: Lossy browser derivative: quantized centers, scales, rotations, color and retained spherical harmonics; alpha threshold 1. Source PLY is unchanged. No scene-coordinate transform.
provenance.mobileMethod: SH0; opacity >=0.02; 15cm cell coverage and opacity budget. Lossy visual derivative; no change to source checkpoint.
provenance.geometryScope: Trained appearance, not surveyed geometry or device identity. Same Cupix scan frame must be verified.
provenance.selectionStatus: Selected local experimental default after completed 1M/2M final-checkpoint comparison; 2M did not materially improve reviewed blur. Not photorealistic or independently surveyed.

validation.scope: Station-held-out validation used during experimentation; no independent final test set.

publication: Published 2026-10-14 at the owner's request as an experimental appearance layer for the May 6 capture only. Same Cupix scan frame as the May registration; not surveyed geometry.
